sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests if the FLSA waives sovereign immunity for Tucker Act claims. The government argues the FLSA has its own remedial scheme. The worker argues the FLSA waives immunity for Tucker Act suits. Courts are split on this interpretation. The outcome affects federal workers' access to courts.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Federal workers need clear access to courts for back pay claims. The FLSA defines the scope of government liability. This case clarifies the relationship between the FLSA and the Tucker Act. It determines how workers seek compensation from the federal government.
